title: Expected Calibration Error
signature: def expected_calibration_error(probs: np.ndarray, labels: np.ndarray, n_bins: int = 10) -> float
hints: Confidence is the max probability in each row, and the prediction is its argmax. A sample is correct when the prediction equals the label.
Bin b covers (b/B, (b+1)/B]: open on the left, closed on the right. np.searchsorted(edges[1:-1], conf, side="left") gives exactly that bin index.
np.bincount with weights= gives each bin's count, confidence sum and correct-count sum in one call each. Weight each bin's |accuracy - confidence| by its share of the samples, and skip empty bins.
